candidate.title: BisChIP-Seq / ChIP-BS-seq
candidate.scope: The assigned lower Illumina poster row jointly illustrates BisChIP-Seq and ChIP-BS-seq as chromatin immunoprecipitation followed by bisulfite conversion and PCR of the recovered DNA. It depicts a histone-methylation example and ends at DNA, with no separate sequencing operation. The adjacent upper MBDCap-seq/Methyl-Cap-seq/MBD-Seq/MiGS row, right-hand chemical graphic and QR code, and footer references are contextual, not connected workflow components. The verified collection heading also mentions ChIP-BMS, but that name is not a target of this assigned schematic. The two target names share this schematic-level strategy; this does not assert identical complete implementations or interchangeability.

states.label: DNA: amplified bisulfite-encoded ChIP library product
features: The sequence example becomes T T T C G after PCR: converted U is represented as T, while the resistant position retains C identity.
The readout carrier is DNA sequence, with chromatin-feature association established by prior immunoprecipitation; histones are not sequenced.

The diagram ends at DNA. Primary evidence identifies this amplified product as a sequencing library and places methylated adapters before conversion; adapter ligation, exact ends and sequencing are not separately drawn here.
Sequencing this library supports base-level methylation estimates at covered positions in the selected chromatin fraction, rather than a complete unbiased genome methylation map.

operations.description: Fragment the DNA in chromatin, changing connected nucleosome-bearing material into shorter chromatin fragments while retaining DNA-protein association for capture.

operations.label: Immunoprecipitate
operations.description: Select chromatin fragments through the antibody-recognized histone feature. The retained complex is antibody-associated; the faded chromatin illustrates material not retained in the selected fraction.
operations.mechanism: Antibody-mediated chromatin immunoprecipitation; H3K27me3-specific antibodies establish the primary-paper histone-mark implementations, while the drawing labels methylated histones generically.
operations.information_effect: Enriches DNA associated with the recognized chromatin feature. Both methylated and unmethylated DNA can be captured; the antibody selection does not establish perfect specificity or measure the DNA methylation state.

operations.label: Purify DNA and shear
operations.description: Recover DNA from the selected DNA-protein complexes and shear it, producing naked ChIP-derived DNA fragments. Retain this as the single composite block drawn, without imposing internal execution details.

operations.label: Bisulfite conversion (Bisulfite)
operations.description: Convert the unmodified C in the DNA sequence explanation to U while the methylation-marked C remains C. The input and output are ChIP-derived DNA; this occurs after immunoprecipitation and DNA purification.
operations.mechanism: Differential response of cytosines to bisulfite treatment, depicted as C-to-U conversion at the unmarked position and resistance at the methylation-marked position.
operations.information_effect: Turns the original DNA methylation distinction into a template-base distinction within the selected chromatin fraction. The schematic idealizes conversion and does not establish complete conversion or discrimination among every cytosine modification.

operations.label: PCR
operations.description: Amplify the converted DNA. In the sequence explanation, U is represented as T in the PCR product and the conversion-resistant C remains C, yielding the final DNA product.
operations.mechanism: PCR, explicitly labelled between the U-containing and T-containing sequence lines.
operations.information_effect: The amplified DNA sequence carries the bisulfite readout of DNA modification in the antibody-selected fraction. Interpret the final marked C as retention of C identity in the sequence readout, rather than a measurement of the amplified molecule’s physical methyl groups.

method_scopes.rationale: Resolved for the illustrated ChIP-BS-seq family implementation. Brinkman et al. (PMID 22466170) establishes ChIP capture of a histone-mark-associated genomic fraction followed by bisulfite conversion, PCR and sequencing. The diagram explicitly groups ChIP-BS-seq with BisChIP-Seq over the same local chromatin-to-DNA route. Thus its purification/shearing block and the resulting preparation history remain in this schematic; downstream conversion is not reassigned to a differently prepared input. Post-ChIP shearing is independently verified for Statham BisChIP-seq, while Brinkman does not explicitly report that additional shearing in the supplied text. This is a shared schematic implementation within the broader ChIP-BS-seq family, not a claim that every ChIP-BS-seq protocol requires a second shear or that the two complete protocols are interchangeable. MethylCap-BS-seq is an alternative in Brinkman Figure 1A, outside the assigned poster row.
